SELECT topic, percentage FROM trend_snapshots
WHERE project_id = '{{ $json.body.project_id }}'
ORDER BY percentage DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT topic_title FROM generated_ideas
WHERE project_id = '{{ $('Webhook: /generate-ideas').item.json.body.project_id }}'
ORDER BY generated_at DESC LIMIT 30

INSERT INTO generated_ideas (id, project_id, topic_title, post_copy, keywords, cta_type, cta_text, image_concept, ai_provider, generated_at, used)
VALUES (
  gen_random_uuid()::text,
  '{{ $('Webhook: /generate-ideas').item.json.body.project_id }}',
  '{{ $json.topic_title.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.post_copy.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.keywords || []) }}'::jsonb,
  '{{ $json.cta_type }}',
  '{{ ($json.cta_text || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.image_concept || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  'gemini',
  NOW(),
  false
)
RETURNING *
